title.zh: 人声轨能发声了：五个合成人声预置已接到轨道
title.en: A vocal lane can be voiced: the five factory vowel patches are wired to tracks

highlights.zh: synthesize_vocal 不再是占位：把某条轨道绑到 synth 的五个 formant 人声预置之一，可按预置 id 或元音选，未知声音/轨道会列全后拒绝。
highlights.en: synthesize_vocal is no longer a stub: it binds a lane to one of the synth's five formant vocal patches, chosen by id or by vowel, refusing an unknown voice or lane with the full list.

highlights.zh: 它如实自报做了哪一半：轨道的声音绑好了，但不做歌声合成（share code 携带声音而非词），歌词仍由 set_arrangement_vocal_melody 绑定。
highlights.en: It says which half it did: the lane sounds through that voice, but it does not synthesise singing — a share code carries a voice, not words — and the lyric is still bound by set_arrangement_vocal_melody.
